    Big Games

    The headliners. Bigger worlds, longer naps afterwards.

    Featured · 01 · itch.io

    Purrpendicular!

    Gravity has gone to the cats. Pop groups of same-colour balls, tilt the whole chamber to build bigger ones, and survive the spinners, pegs and bumpers.

    Play Purrpendicular! on itch.io ↗(itch.io)

    Featured · 02 · itch.io

    Meowntain

    Drop cat cards. Same cats squish into bigger cats. Climb the Meowntain through 36 levels, 13 cats and a café that fills with every cat you make.

    Play Meowntain on itch.io ↗(itch.io)

    Featured · 03 · Free on Steam

    Purr Bricks

    Smash through 100+ brick-packed levels. Grab wild powerups, dodge chaotic curses and build up FURY for board-clearing strikes.

    Get Purr Bricks on Steam ↗(Steam)

    Featured · 04 · Catridge-32 cart

    Reactor Purr

    Fly in. Blow the core. Get out alive. You’re a space cat, and 24 stations full of mouse fighters stand between you and home. One of the carts in Catridge-32.

    Play it in Catridge-32 on itch.io ↗(itch.io)

    Collection · itch.io

    Catridge

    A 1983 console that never existed, loaded with 32 cat arcade carts. Blow on the contacts, slot one in, and lose an afternoon.
